# 客户标签变更事件

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /{path}:
    post:
      summary: 客户标签变更事件
      deprecated: false
      description: ''
      tags:
        - 客户管理/客户标签
      parameters:
        - name: host
          in: path
          description: ''
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: path
          in: path
          description: ''
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: appKey
          in: query
          description: 企业的appKey，0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
          required: true
          example: '{{appKey}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: time
          in: query
          description: 当前 UTC 时间戳，从 1970 年 1 月 1 日 0 点 0 分 0 秒开始到现在的秒数,1463217187
          required: true
          example: '{{time}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: checksum
          in: query
          description: >-
            SHA1(appSecret + md5 + time),
            三个参数拼接的字符串，进行SHA1哈希计算，转化成16进制字符(String，小写).示例2f13932c4b7c6888b12360a85261a11b8b543f64 
          required: true
          example: '{{checksum}} '
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                userid:
                  type: integer
                  description: 访客的foreignid
                foreignid:
                  type: string
                  description: 访客在七鱼的id
                tag_ids:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: integer
                  description: 标签id数组，标签id通过/openapi/tag/all接口查询
                type:
                  type: string
                  description: save表示为用户增加对应标签，delete表示从用户标签中删除对应标签。
              required:
                - userid
                - foreignid
                - tag_ids
                - type
            example:
              userid: 12451558
              foreignid: onlyone
              tag_ids:
                - 156656
                - 2455485
              type: save
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                    description: 错误码。200表示设置成功。
                  message:
                    type: string
                    description: 错误提示信息
                required:
                  - code
                  - message
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: 客户管理/客户标签
      x-apifox-status: released
```
